description: The ERC-20, ERC-721 and ERC-1155 balances of an address (at most 100 tokens), each with the token's address, name, symbol, type, decimals, the raw balance and the balance in whole tokens (raw ÷ 10^decimals). LAX itself is not a token: use explorer_address or get_balance. Names, symbols, tags and method names are set by whoever deployed or verified a contract and are wrapped as untrusted.
name: explorer_token_balances
title: Token balances
